what: A dark glass pill (8px blur translucent face + 1px white border) — when the cursor touches the button, the face swells to 1.045× over .4s and brightens (.15s), and a light 5.6rem in diameter gathers at the cursor position (.35s). Following the cursor, the face is pulled by .33× its distance from center (up to 13px) and the text by only .06× (up to 3px) over .25s, creating layers. Once attached it follows up to 16px outside the box, and when the cursor leaves, the face (after .9s) and the text (after .15s) bounce back to rest with a 1.35s elastic (elastic.out(1, .35)).

options.reach: Distance (px) it keeps following outside the box after sticking, default 16
options.back: Release duration (seconds), default .9 — text is delayed by × slower (default 1.5) and lag (default .15s)
options.[data-fx-part=surface]: Glass surface (the button itself if none)

note: Only the mouse drags — with touch or reduced motion only the brightening remains
